jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.summary: Lead national communications strategy, media relations, digital and content strategy, crisis communications, executive counsel, team leadership and athlete storytelling.
jobs.fit: AthletesCAN and Canadian Olympic Committee experience directly match national sport storytelling, media leadership and high-performance athlete communications; UJA adds senior counsel and editorial leadership.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 10 years of progressive experience versus approximately nine documented; French is a strong asset but not required, and frequent travel is required.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing & Communications
jobs.summary: Lead marketing strategy and execution for the Foundation's events portfolio, campaigns and social media in support of its $500M Here for Life campaign.
jobs.fit: Directly relevant to UJA's large-scale philanthropic campaign communications, donor storytelling, stakeholder engagement and hands-on campaign delivery.
jobs.gap: Events are the primary portfolio focus; the role has no direct reports and requires substantial hands-on project execution.

jobs.company: University Health Network / Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation
jobs.title: Manager, Communications
jobs.summary: Lead earned media, strategic relationships with Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, senior communications counsel, and issues/crisis communications.
jobs.fit: UJA's $78M+ annual campaign content and senior-leadership advisory align with philanthropic storytelling; AthletesCAN adds primary media-contact experience.
jobs.gap: Direct health/science media relationships and demonstrated ownership of crisis communications are not established.

jobs.title: Public Relations Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Own Canada's earned-media function, develop proactive and reactive PR practices, manage media inquiries, and execute integrated communications plans and story development.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, AthletesCAN media relations and national sport storytelling align directly with earned media, proactive story development and integrated communications planning.
jobs.gap: Automotive, marketplace or travel-sector experience is preferred; it is not presented as a strict requirement.

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Canada
jobs.summary: Develop integrated internal and external communications, executive and change communications, associate engagement campaigns, issues support, thought leadership and multi-channel content.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-leadership counsel, SharePoint and digital content experience, campaign planning and AthletesCAN media work align with the broad internal/external remit.
jobs.gap: French is strongly preferred but not required; direct ownership of large-scale corporate change communications is not explicit in the resume details.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications Manager II
jobs.summary: Lead corporate communications initiatives and advise stakeholders on strategic messaging, media relations and communications priorities.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-stakeholder counsel, strategic campaign communications, editorial judgment and AthletesCAN media experience align with integrated communications leadership.
jobs.gap: Experience supporting capital markets, wholesale banking or financial services is preferred and is not established.

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Equinix Foundation
jobs.summary: Lead global Foundation communications, brand narrative, thought leadership, community-impact storytelling, LinkedIn content strategy and impact reporting.
jobs.fit: UJA philanthropic storytelling and large-scale campaign communications, combined with AthletesCAN digital storytelling and senior-stakeholder work, align closely with impact narrative development.
jobs.gap: Direct ESG/CSR and digital-inclusion subject experience is not established; the role operates across a global, matrixed organization.

jobs.title: External Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Support media relations, crisis communications and executive voice for a social-impact technology company.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, AthletesCAN media experience, UJA nonprofit context and executive-facing storytelling are relevant to external reputation and thought leadership.
jobs.gap: The role seeks substantial B2B technology media and crisis-communications experience; that specialization is not established.

jobs.title: Marketing Communications Manager — Canada (6-Month Contract)
jobs.summary: Build Canadian storytelling across earned media, customer communications, content, thought leadership and social; manage external PR and social agencies.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, UJA editorial planning and AthletesCAN digital communications align with integrated storytelling, agency management and campaign measurement.
jobs.gap: SaaS and small-business/accountant audiences are a learning curve; direct technology-sector communications experience is not established.

jobs.title: Product & Technology Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Build product and technology communications strategy, explain complex AI work, support launches and executive thought leadership, and partner with product, research and engineering teams.
jobs.fit: Jacob's research training, editorial strategy, digital storytelling and senior-stakeholder counsel transfer to clear narratives for complex subjects.
jobs.gap: The role seeks 5–7 years in product/technology communications, ideally AI or enterprise software; that specialist track record is not established.

jobs.title: Senior Staff GTM Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Own global go-to-market communications channels and live experiences, including all-hands, Sales Kickoff programming, onboarding and executive messaging.
jobs.fit: UJA leadership-facing content, national campaigns and AthletesCAN/COC digital and event communications provide foundations in executive messaging and cross-functional delivery.
jobs.gap: Direct B2B SaaS go-to-market, sales enablement and revenue-team communications experience is not established; the role expects 8+ years in a related field.
